title: FOMC decision (meeting Dec 7-8, 2027, with SEP) — the year's final meeting and the SEP that sets the 2028 dots
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this session (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, page stamp 'Last Update: August 19, 2026') and re-parsed panel by panel. The 2027 panel reads verbatim 'January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*' under the page's own footnote '* Meeting associated with a Summary of Economic Projections' -- December 7-8 CARRIES the asterisk and therefore a SEP. Dec 7 2027 is a Tuesday and Dec 8 a Wednesday, consistent with the two-day convention, and the decision day is the Wednesday. SECOND, NON-FED PRIMARY ON THE SAME DATE: Kalshi's KXFEDDECISION-27DEC event, read direct from the exchange API this session, strikes 2027-12-08T19:00:00Z with contracts closing 18:59:00Z (13:59 ET under EST, the same 14:00 ET convention the 27OCT contract carries at 18:00Z under EDT -- so the ladder is ET-anchored across the DST boundary, not UTC-anchored). A venue is not a Board primary and promotes nothing; it is an independent statement of the same date. The panel parse is the same assertion-checked one the proposing lane's own entry documents -- panels cut at their own footnote block (the 2027 footnote names a January 25-26, 2028 meeting that a year-scoped parse would return as a phantom ninth 2027 meeting), cross-month labels expanded and consumed first, the Board's own (unscheduled)/(cancelled) flags excluded -- returning 167 scheduled meetings, exactly 8 in every year 2007-2027 except 2020's 7. Filed estimate because the same page states verbatim 'Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it', and the meeting immediately preceding this one is 2027-10-26/27 -- the proposing lane's own event. The 14:00 ET statement time is the standing convention and is not on this page. Discovered during the fomc-2027-10-26 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-2027-10-26 initial research (2026-09-06) because its adjacency sweep found a hole rather than an event. This calendar tracks SEVEN of the eight 2027 FOMC meetings -- 01-27, 03-17, 04-28, 06-09, 07-28, 09-15 and (as of this PR) 10-26 -- and carries NOTHING for December 7-8, the year's final meeting, its final SEP, and the meeting that publishes the 2028 dot path. That is the largest single gap left in the 2027 rate roster. THE PROPOSING LANE HAS A DIRECT INTEREST AND STATES IT: fomccalendars.htm's own tentative-date rule makes the 2027-10-26/27 meeting the CONFIRMING VENUE for this date, so this entry is the thing whose promotion the proposer's own forward test is scored against. Filing it as an estimate the proposer owns, rather than leaving the hole for whichever lane trips over it next, is the same reasoning fomc-2027-09-15 used when it proposed vix-expiration-2027-09-15 and opex-2027-09-17 into an empty corridor. TWO FACTS THE PROPOSER MEASURED THAT BEAR ON THIS ENTRY, both from the 167-meeting parse and CBOE's SPX_History.csv (13,028 bars to 1975), and both offered as context rather than as this event's research: (a) the autumn-to-December decision gap is 42 days here, the MODAL value -- 10 of the 21 years 2007-2027 run 42 days, 6 run 41 and 5 run 48-49 -- so nothing about the December meeting's spacing is unusual; (b) December carries the HIGHEST monthly mean absolute S&P decision-day move in the table, 1.265% at n=19 against 0.925% across all 156 decision days 2007-2026, and unlike September's and October's cells that one has not been shown to be a mixture or a bin-split artifact -- whoever researches this id should test it before quoting it, because the two cells this family has tested both failed. IMPACT HIGH matching every other decision-day entry in the family. SAME CHANNEL CAVEAT AS EVERY RATE ENTRY: symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
